title: I Never Thought I'd Be a Programmer. Yet Here I Am.
why_read: A personal career-change memoir about becoming a programmer later in life, with little technical content for an engineering audience.
analysis: This piece is a first-person reflection on growing up around computers and eventually deciding to pursue programming and an IT degree as an adult. It contains no technical details, code, or engineering insight, focusing instead on personal motivation and nostalgia. It may resonate emotionally with career-changers but offers nothing substantive for a technically focused digest. It is reasonable content for a general audience blog but out of place in a digest meant to surface genuine technical interest.
